description: Two lobes connected by a narrow neck, with only one portal — the autopilot enters from the south, can explore either lobe + the neck, and ultimately leaves the same way. The south lobe holds the gate; the north lobe is a dead-end pocket with two corner detours of its own. Same hourglass geometry as ib2 but with the north gate removed.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-0.26, 23.49) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side of the south lobe

traversalNotes: Dead-end hourglass variant of ib2: same two-lobe-plus-neck geometry, but only the south lobe has a portal. The autopilot enters from spawn_south, does its in-cell work, and leaves through the same gate.
Furthest-corner traversal: spawn_south → south_lobe_mid → neck_south → neck_north → north_lobe_(west|east). Five hops to reach the north lobe; reverse to exit.
DISPATCH RULE: objectives in each lobe route via the lobe_mid (south) or via the neck_north pivot (north — there's no north_lobe_mid). Corner detours stay children of their lobe's pivot.
Neck is narrow and the inter-lobe void is not walkable — strict-backbone applies to the neck_south ↔ neck_north edge.
Same primitive as ib2 (hourglass) with one gate removed. Solver should treat as ib2 with a closed portal.
